text_en: Pursue love and strive for the spiritual gifts, and especially that you may prophesy.
text_cn: 你们要追求爱，但也要渴慕神恩，尤其是要渴慕做先知之恩。

text_en: For those who speak in a tongue do not speak to other people but to God; for nobody understands them, since they are speaking mysteries in the Spirit.
text_cn: 原来那说语言的，不是对人，而是对天主说话，因为没有人听得懂，他是由于神魂讲论奥秘的事；

text_en: On the other hand, those who prophesy speak to other people for their upbuilding and encouragement and consolation.
text_cn: 但那做先知的，却是向人说建树、劝慰和鼓励的话。

text_en: Those who speak in a tongue build up themselves, but those who prophesy build up the church.
text_cn: 那说语言的，是建立自己；那讲先知话的，却是建立教会。

text_en: Now I would like all of you to speak in tongues, but even more to prophesy. One who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets, so that the church may be built up.
text_cn: 我愿意你们都有说语言之恩，但我更愿意你们都做先知，因为讲先知话的比说语言的更大，除非他也解释，使教会获得建立。

text_en: Now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you in some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
text_cn: 弟兄们！假使我来到你们那里，只说语言，若不以启示，或以知识，或以先知话，或以训诲向你们讲论，我为你们有什么益处？

text_en: It is the same way with lifeless instruments that produce sound, such as the flute or the harp. If they do not give distinct notes, how will anyone know what is being played?
text_cn: 就连那些无灵而发声之物，箫也罢，琴也罢，若分不清声调，怎能知道所吹所弹的是什么呢？

text_en: And if the bugle gives an indistinct sound, who will get ready for battle?
text_cn: 若号筒吹的音调不准确，谁还准备作战呢？

text_en: So with yourselves; if in a tongue you utter speech that is not intelligible, how will anyone know what is being said? For you will be speaking into the air.
text_cn: 同样，你们若不用舌头说出明晰的话，人怎能明白你说的是什么？那么，你们就是向空气说话。

text_en: There are doubtless many different kinds of sounds in the world, and nothing is without sound.
text_cn: 谁也知道世界上有很多语言，但没有一种是没有意义的。

text_en: If then I do not know the meaning of a sound, I will be a foreigner to the speaker and the speaker a foreigner to me.
text_cn: 假使我不明白那语言的意义，那说话的人必以我为蛮夷，我也以那说话的人为蛮夷。

text_en: So with yourselves; since you are eager for spiritual gifts, strive to excel in them for building up the church.
text_cn: 你们也当这样：你们既然渴慕神恩，就当祈求多得建立教会的恩赐。

text_en: Therefore, one who speaks in a tongue should pray for the power to interpret.
text_cn: 为此，那说语言的应当祈求解释之恩，

text_en: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays but my mind is unproductive.
text_cn: 因为我若以语言之恩祈祷，是我的神魂祈祷，我的理智却得不到效果。

text_en: What should I do then? I will pray with the spirit, but I will pray with the mind also; I will sing praise with the spirit, but I will sing praise with the mind also.
text_cn: 那么怎样才行呢？我要以神魂祈祷，也要以理智祈祷；我要以神魂歌咏，也要以理智歌咏；

text_en: Otherwise, if you say a blessing with the spirit, how can anyone in the position of an outsider say the “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since the outsider does not know what you are saying?
text_cn: 不然，假使你以神魂赞颂，那在场不通语言的人，既不明白你说什么，对你的祝谢辞，怎能答应“阿们”呢？

text_en: For you may give thanks well enough, but the other person is not built up.
text_cn: 你固然祝谢的很好，可是不能建立别人。

text_en: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you;
text_cn: 我感谢天主，我说语言胜过你们众人；

text_en: nevertheless, in church I would rather speak five words with my mind, in order to instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
text_cn: 可是在集会中，我宁愿以我的理智说五句训诲人的话，而不愿以语言之恩说一万句话。

text_en: Brothers and sisters, do not be children in your thinking; rather, be infants in evil, but in thinking be adults.
text_cn: 弟兄们！你们在见识上不应做孩子，但应在邪恶上做婴孩，在见识上应做成年人。

text_en: In the law it is written, “By people of strange tongues and by the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people; yet even then they will not listen to me, ” says the Lord.
text_cn: 法律上记载：“上主说：我要藉说外方话的人和外方人的嘴唇向这百姓说话，虽然这样，他们还是不听从我。”

text_en: Tongues, then, are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers, while prophecy is not for unbelievers but for believers.
text_cn: 这样看来，语言之恩不是为信的人作证据，而是为不信的人；但先知之恩不是为不信的人，而是为信的人。

text_en: If, therefore, the whole church comes together and all speak in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are out of your mind?
text_cn: 所以全教会共同聚在一起时，假使众人都说起语言来，如有不通的人，或不信的人进来，岂不要说：你们疯了吗？

text_en: But if all prophesy, an unbeliever or outsider who enters is reproved by all and called to account by all.
text_cn: 但是，如果众人都说先知话，即便有不信的人或不通的人进来，他必被众人说服，也必被众人所审察，

text_en: After the secrets of the unbeliever’s heart are disclosed, that person will bow down before God and worship him, declaring, “God is really among you. ”
text_cn: 他心内的隐密事也必会显露出来：这样他就必俯首至地朝拜天主，声称天主实在是在你们中间。

text_en: What should be done then, my friends? When you come together, each one has a hymn, a lesson, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.
text_cn: 弟兄们！那么怎样做呢？当你们聚会的时候，每人不论有什么神恩，或有歌咏，或有训诲，或有启示，或有语言，或有解释之恩：一切都应为建立而行。

text_en: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let there be only two or at most three, and each in turn; and let one interpret.
text_cn: 倘若有说语言的，只可两个人，或至多三个人，且要轮流讲话，也要有一个人解释；

text_en: But if there is no one to interpret, let them be silent in church and speak to themselves and to God.
text_cn: 如没有解释的人，在集会中就该缄默，只可对自己和对天主说话。

text_en: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others weigh what is said.
text_cn: 至于先知，可以两个人，或三个人说话，其余的人要审辨。

text_en: If a revelation is made to someone else sitting nearby, let the first person be silent.
text_cn: 若在坐的有一位得了启示，那先说话的，就不应该再发言，

text_en: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all be encouraged.
text_cn: 因为你们都可一个一个的说先知话，为使众人学习，为使众人受到鼓励。

text_en: And the spirits of prophets are subject to the prophets,
text_cn: 并且先知的神魂是由先知自己作主，

text_en: for God is a God not of disorder but of peace. (As in all the churches of the saints,
text_cn: 因为天主不是混乱的天主，而是平安的天主。

text_en: women should be silent in the churches. For they are not permitted to speak, but should be subordinate, as the law also says.
text_cn: 犹如在圣徒的众教会内，妇女在集会中应当缄默；她们不准发言，只该服从，正如法律所说的。

text_en: If there is anything they desire to know, let them ask their husbands at home. For it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.
text_cn: 她们若愿意学什么，可以在家里问自己的丈夫；因为在集会中发言，为女人不是体面事。

text_en: Or did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached? )
text_cn: 莫非天主的道理是从你们来的吗？或是惟独临到了你们身上吗？

text_en: Anyone who claims to be a prophet, or to have spiritual powers, must acknowledge that what I am writing to you is a command of the Lord.
text_cn: 若有人自以为是先知，或受神感的人，就该承认我给你们所写的，是主的诫命。

text_en: Anyone who does not recognize this is not to be recognized.
text_cn: 谁若不承认，也不要承认他。

text_en: So, my friends, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues;
text_cn: 所以，我的弟兄们！你们应当渴慕说先知话，可是也不要禁止人说语言。

text_en: but all things should be done decently and in order.
text_cn: 一切都该照规矩按次序而行。
